notes: Added complete story set for Manifest Snapshot Freshness (schema, logic, API, tests, integration).

BL-0.1.4-006-S1.title: Define Manifest Snapshot Freshness Schema and Contract
BL-0.1.4-006-S1.description: Define metadata schema for manifest snapshots including timestamp, source hash, generation version, and freshness TTL policy used to determine validity before execution.

BL-0.1.4-006-S2.title: Implement Manifest Freshness Evaluation Logic
BL-0.1.4-006-S2.description: Build logic to evaluate whether a manifest snapshot is fresh based on TTL, file hash drift, and last generation timestamp; return pass/fail with reason.

BL-0.1.4-006-S3.title: Expose Manifest Freshness Status via Internal API
BL-0.1.4-006-S3.description: Provide an internal API or callable interface that returns current manifest freshness status and triggers regeneration requirement if stale.

BL-0.1.4-006-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Manifest Freshness
BL-0.1.4-006-S4.description: Create tests covering TTL expiry, hash mismatch, valid snapshot pass, and stale snapshot detection across manifest generation and read workflows.

BL-0.1.4-006-S5.title: Integrate Freshness Check into Execution Pipeline
BL-0.1.4-006-S5.description: Integrate freshness validation into dev_pipeline and brain_runner execution paths to ensure stale manifests trigger regeneration before use.

BL-0.1.4-006.mitigation: Default to regeneration when freshness status is uncertain.
